title: ACADEMIC VERIFICATION CONSENT FORM
text:
EXPLANATORY NOTE FOR THE “AUTHORISATION FOR RELEASE OF
ACADEMIC RECORDS” FORM (IF APPLICABLE)
This form is a supplementary form to the Personality Notes Form and the Abridged Personality
Notes form.
Who Should Complete this Form?
It only applies to applicants or nominees who:
1. have pursued or are currently pursuing higher educational/ professional /vocational
program in a school/institution outside Ghana.
2. are in possession of academic or professional certificate(s) which were issued by an
institution outside Ghana.
What is Required When Completing the Form?
1. The form must be fully completed, signed and dated by the nominee or applicant described
above.
2. Applicant is required to indicate the full address of each school/institution attended either
at the top right corner of each completed form or next to the name of the school indicated.
3. Provide student ID number on each form.
How Many Forms Must be Completed by Applicants?
1. Each form must be addressed to each school/institution attended outside Ghana.
2. The applicant or nominee is only permitted to consolidate his/her educational history on
one form for the same school/institution if he/she pursued or is pursuing multiple
educational programs in that school/institution at different times in the said
school/institution outside Ghana. In other words, an applicant or nominee can fill one form
if multiple certificates were issued to the applicant by one school/institution.
NB:
Kindly note that applicants or nominees who are completing the Abridged Personality Notes
form are required to complete this form, purposely for newly obtained
professional/academic qualification(s) which were obtained outside Ghana, after the NIC
had approved them for more than two years.
